name: ECVAM Virtual Lab (EN, FR, IT)
summary:
## Dive into the Future of Science: the ECVAM Virtual Lab

Embark on a 20-minute virtual adventure, designed for students aged 14-18 but equally engaging for older learners. Step into the ECVAM virtual lab and join a friendly professor on a journey to explore a new alternative to animal testing method. You will conduct experiments, just like in a real laboratory, to evaluate the reproducibility of a test method.
